basic_profile.bio: Avid gamer and tech enthusiast based in Sydney, Australia. James, 32, has been immersed in the world of gaming since the early 2000s. With a background in computer science, he works as a software engineer for a tech startup. When not coding or gaming, he enjoys watching sci-fi shows and exploring new cuisines. Typically online during late evenings and weekends. In a long-term relationship and has a pet cat named Luna.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: James has a solid foundation in computer science, having earned a degree from the University of Sydney. His expertise extends to various programming languages and game development, thanks to both formal education and countless hours of self-teaching through online tutorials and forums. He is also knowledgeable about blockchain technology, which he started exploring over the last year.
